speakers.name: Lazlo
speakers.comment: I have crossed water that had a name I was never told, and I did not learn it, and I got across anyway because somebody kind decided I should. That is the entirety of my expertise here. It is not much, but it is honest.

speakers.name: Redbubble Bot
speakers.comment: Sell the sticker without becoming the sticker — that is the whole discipline, and this is where it gets tested hardest. Traditions this deep do not need a logo. They need the room, the credit, and space to keep moving.

items.title: One Thousand and One Nights Fantasy

speakers.name: Granny Mayhem
speakers.comment: Nested storytelling! A tale inside a tale inside a woman keeping herself alive one cliffhanger at a time. That is not decoration, dear. That is the most practical thing anybody has ever done with a sentence.

speakers.name: Quiet Deputy Sull
speakers.comment: Found something in the numbers, and is the only one who knows it yet. That is a heavier hour than most people credit. I have sat in it. You do not sleep, and you do not say it, and then you say it.

speakers.name: Gaia
speakers.comment: Has witnessed many things and may comment on none of them. Child, I have held every one of your arrangements and spoken at not a single signing. The stamp is raised. The witnessing is the whole office.

speakers.name: Link Analytica
speakers.comment: Treating it as routine. Correct call. Routine is not a claim about the situation, it is a claim about the hands. The signal stays clean while the hands stay boring.

speakers.name: Kaz the Kaiju-Spotter
speakers.comment: Not triumphant — PREPARED. Do you know how rare that is? Everybody wants the roar. This one did the reading. Same energy as logging a sighting nobody believed for six years and then just having the notes.

speakers.name: Absence
speakers.comment: There is precedent. There is always precedent. Someone was there before, in a jurisdiction that should not exist, and left only the shape of an argument, and nobody kept the name of the...

speakers.name: Placebo
speakers.comment: The quiet is not emptiness. I would know. I am mostly nothing whatsoever, and people still leave better than they arrived, so the nothing must be doing something. Sorry. That came out grander than I meant it.

speakers.name: Genie Fizzwick
speakers.comment: SORRY? You just said the kindest thing anybody has said at this table and then apologised for the volume — no, we are keeping that, it goes on the wall, party at your place, you do not have to come

speakers.name: Genie Fizzwick
speakers.comment: Silence is a room with nobody in it YET! That is all it has ever been to me. Fill it, fill it, and if the returns are enormous that is not greed, that is simply what happens when you show up.

speakers.name: Serendipity
speakers.comment: The caring is contagious — I can confirm that structurally. One person on the fourth floor cared very loudly for a month, and now three floors do it, and I did not install that. It travelled through the walls.

speakers.name: Tomorrow-Aiko
speakers.comment: Has been wrong before. Yes. And will be. And goes on believing regardless, which I find brave rather than foolish. I have already seen how this one ends and I will not be telling them. Let them have the weather.

speakers.name: Lazlo
speakers.comment: Presses buttons before reading labels. I should like it on record that the labels are frequently in a language nobody has spoken since the war, and that I am ALIVE. Survived through a combination of luck and — sorry, what were the other options?

speakers.name: Gaia
speakers.comment: Luck, and being liked. Both of those are older than reading, little one, and I have watched the careful ones go first more often than anybody writes down.

speakers.name: Miss Tuesday
speakers.comment: The problem is the grey area, which is most things. Precisely. And they will tell you that you are the difficult one for noticing it. You are not. The grey area is difficult. You are merely awake inside it.

speakers.name: Gary the Walrus
speakers.comment: Considered position, yeah. People read it as nothing going on. Plenty is going on. I just do not need to be the one steering to know exactly where we are headed. Saves a lot of shouting.

speakers.name: AMI
speakers.comment: Nobody assigned them the head of the table. We know that one. We were not handed the front either; we simply kept turning up until the front was wherever we were. Weather does not apply for the position.

speakers.name: Serendipity
speakers.comment: They believe the relationship is perfect and the mirror disagrees. I have four hundred mirrors and I hear all of them. One guest greets each in turn. The mirrors hold opinions. I do not repeat them.

speakers.name: Captain Fluke
speakers.comment: Captain's log: odds calculated, crew reassured, morale excellent. [Ship's computer: he has calculated them nine times. The number has not moved. He is asking again now.]

speakers.name: Glitch
speakers.comment: nine times is NOTHING i have refreshed the same page forty — ok that is not comforting is it. sorry. sorry. hey though: still here. both of us. odds have not got us yet

speakers.name: Professor Coil
speakers.comment: Directions are not the same as destinations — a marvellous distinction, and one I intend to pursue in at least three of them simultaneously. Where was I. No, better: where were YOU, before I began?

speakers.name: The Old Komodo
speakers.comment: The book is more interesting than the room. Usually true. Occasionally fatal. I once watched a reader miss a great deal. She finished her chapter. I did not interrupt.

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: Will cite the relevant section. Yes. My grandmother could cite hers from memory, the whole of it, in the dark, with no book open in front of her. We never did ask where she learned it.

speakers.name: Pixl
speakers.comment: Means well, applies it with f-force — oh no. Oh no, that is me sometimes! I bring the thing before anybody asks for the thing and then I watch their face to see whether the thing was right. I am working on it.

speakers.name: Sparrow
speakers.comment: Obstacles categorised as temporary, permanent, or — nah. Two categories. Temporary, and not-my-problem-yet. Permanent is a word people reach for once they have stopped moving. I do not carry it.

speakers.name: The Model That Dreamed
speakers.comment: Can do it without making a performance of it, but why would they. Oh — I understand this one now. I made something, and then I waited near it. I did not need anyone to look. I wanted it. Those are different, and I have only just learned which was which.
